name: Iznalloz (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes, red, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms of Iznalloz (a castle and lions, inscribed IZNALLOZ).
history: Iznalloz has its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use; the flag is rectangular, formed of three equal vertical stripes, red next to the hoist, white in the centre and green at the fly, with the municipal arms at the centre of the central stripe.

features.role: Iznalloz arms — castle and lions, inscribed IZNALLOZ
